item.title: The Ledger We Never Meant to Open
item.description:
I open the laptop for one episode. I look up and it’s 2 a.m.

I’ve lived this scene enough times to write the next one without needing to live it first: the flat, heavy feeling of a day lost, the promise that tomorrow will be different, that I’ll finally read instead, study instead, write instead. Sometimes tomorrow is that day. Sometimes it’s a week of those days. Then, without any single dramatic failure I can point to, I’m back where I started.
